newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end higher on payment demands.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end higher on payment demands.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed higher on Thursday reflecting routine payment demands that tightened liquidity in the banking system, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate ended at 6.224 percent against Wednesday's 6.095 close, with 30-day commercial paper against 6.25-6.35 percent against 6.00-6.25.
Dealers said they expected the rates to hover at the current high levels due to strong liquidity demand.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.1425-6.1430 percent against 6.1500-6.1550 and the seven-year 86/3 bond yield was at 5.9500. -- James Lin (5080815)
